notes.NOT_A_DISTINCT_CUSTOM_COUNT: Counts mix named customs, provisional group proposals, historical rite leads, overlapping existing identities and newly recovered observation leads. No unique-custom count can be calculated by summing them.
notes.PREVIEW_DUPLICATION: 16 preview items overlap 15 of the 111 1956 scan records, not additional observations.
notes.INTRA_AUTHOR_SOURCES: Two Weiser books do not amount to independent corroboration.
notes.FULLNESS: 1958 Handbook's six overlooked observations prove its earlier 568-item index was not exhaustive. 1956 book full-scan pass likewise not certified page-by-page exhaustive.
notes.PRODUCT_BOUNDARY: No Ad Orientem runtime publication or prioritization.
notes.GRANULAR_DETAIL_NON_ADDITIVITY: 340 source detail rows comprise subpractices, regional variants, historical context and potential missing customs. Their overlap with the 568 Handbook original observations and one another is not yet resolved. 1025 research rows are NOT 1025 unique customs.
notes.POTENTIAL_UNINDEXED_NEED_GATE: 34 early-chapter details lack an appropriate source-index parent; they require manual identity review before being counted as distinct customs.
notes.EARLY_UNINDEXED_PRACTICE_LEADS: 24 additional source-bounded group leads were created from 34 early-chapter unmatched detail observations. 10 others are either variants, historical background, other-rite comparison, or folk belief. Do not sum 371 provisional groups and the 56 master identities as confirmed distinct customs.
notes.RECONCILIATION_INTERPRETATION: 340 detail records now have explicit routes; 371 provisional practice groups each have an identity-review row; 111 Family observations and 53 geographic families have relation rows. 54 co-association pairs are NOT verified same customs. No merges or new practice certification.
notes.POST_53_UNASSIGNED_CASE_REVIEW: All 53 formerly unassigned detail records now have specific action-level triage; 37 noncanonical practice or reported folklore groups from 36 cases, one related to a prior group, 16 contextual/comparative. No exact identity merges or global distinctness certified. Older 371-group reconciliation remains its own immutable snapshot.
notes.POST_54_COASSOCIATION_REVIEW: All 54 shared-owner/source pairs classified by likely action mismatch or possible regional subpractice. No pair was certified as identical; shared feast/master label never justifies automatic merging.
notes.MCLOUGHLIN_REPRINT_CAUTION: EWTN transcription attributed to Helen McLoughlin's 1954 Family Advent Customs includes postal ZIP codes in endnotes (which postdate 1954), so it cannot automatically be treated as a word-for-word 1954 first edition. Use EWTN online line locators and independently worded labels; do not attribute each wording to 1954.
notes.MCLOUGHLIN_NOT_UNIQUE_CUSTOMS: 70 new source observations grouped into 26 source action families, not 70 new customs or 26 confirmed distinct identities. Same action may appear in both Weiser and McLoughlin; author cites Weiser.
notes.STOKES_COMPILATION_DEPENDENCY: Fr. Stokes 1955 is an additional separately authored source, but substantial passages depend on Maria von Trapp, Therese Mueller, Donald Attwater, Katherine Byles and other prior witnesses. 198 EWTN source-located action observations do NOT establish 198 independently attested or distinct practices.
notes.STOKES_RITUAL_AND_DATE_CAUTION: Stokes's 1955 imprimatur is historical and does not validate specific blessing texts, indulgences, or current/1962 Roman Ritual ownership. No printed page numbers claimed; all locators refer to EWTN web lines, which may shift.
notes.CATHOLICCULTURE_EXCERPT_WITNESS: 132 independently worded observations from 29 CatholicCulture excerpt pages attributed to Trapp (54), Berger (21), and Newland (57). ONLINE EXCERPT LOCATORS ONLY: No printed pages audited and no full-book completeness claim. CatholicCulture is a reproduction host, not three more independent authors. Do not treat Stokes/McLoughlin retellings as independent confirmation or these observations as distinct Catholic customs. Ritual claims need 1962 Roman Ritual validation.
notes.MUELLER_KELLY_WITNESS_SCOPE: Mueller 1955-labelled EWTN full-text online transcription 122 line-located descriptions and Kelly 1959 Chapter 16 EWTN text 82 line-located descriptions. No printed editions page-audited. The action labels often split a paragraph into separate related practices, not evidence of 204 unique customs. Church rites, sacraments and family devotions distinct; current approval unverified. Source-dependency links to Weiser, McLoughlin, Stokes and others unresolved.
notes.MUELLER_SECOND_PASS_100_NONADDITIVE: Another independent indexing pass recorded 100 shorter source-action details from the SAME online fifth-edition Mueller witness already represented by 122 primary Mueller source rows in the Mueller/Kelly intake. 95/100 second-pass entries co-locate to an EWTN line already cited by primary records; five need separate fine-detail review. These 100 are preserved as source-splitting annotations, NOT added to 1,629 total or 122 original Mueller observations, and NOT new independent corroboration.
notes.STOKES_MUELLER_298_SCREEN_NOT_IDENTITY_A: 298 rows (198 Stokes + 100 Mueller second-pass annotations) were run through label-only candidate lookup across 490 existing owner/group/source-family labels; 119 have one or more retrieval hints, 179 none. No lexical hit or no-hit establishes identity, nonidentity, distinctness, corroboration or ritual authority; the 100 Mueller annotations also overlap the primary 122.
notes.CHANEY_NEW_AUTHOR_NOT_170_VERIFIED_CUSTO: Chaney's 1955 Grailville Twelve Days of Christmas is a distinct authored book and textual witness, but cites or draws on Mueller and earlier authors and includes modern recommendations alongside reported practice, ritual quotations and firsthand Grailville activities. Index 170 as source observations, not 170 new customs or 170 independent corroborations; avoid old printed page citations.
notes.CHANEY_AUTOMATED_RETRIEVAL_IS_NOT_SEMANT: 170 Chaney source observations compared lexically to 490 master/provisional/McLoughlin-family labels plus 604 prior named author source-observation labels. Candidate hints include obvious false positives; 65 observations without hints are not proven novel. Do not promote to master or Calendar.
notes.CHANEY_MANUAL_LABEL_RELATIONS_SCOPE: 24 manually compared source-action labels and Chaney text locator to prior research/source labels: 12 same described action core; 6 explicitly false lexical matches; other relationships include components, preparation or related actions. This is not full dual-source original text verification or proof of separate independent witnesses; zero final merges and no new canonical identities.
notes.FRANCE_PCI_127_MULTICOMPONENT_ETHNOGRAPH: Two distinct French regional inventory documents: Breton pardons (2020: 71 details) and Basque Besta Berri (2018: 56 details), TWO practice complexes, not 127 newly distinct customs. Includes ritual acts, community preparations, historic variants, and folk beliefs. 1962 ritual authority not checked.

source_observations.combined_distinct_source_rows_note: 685 independently numbered base source-observation rows (574 Handbook + 111 Family), plus 340 overlapping Handbook detail records = 1,025 research rows, not 1,025 distinct customs.
source_observations.external_plus_weiser_count_note: 1,025 Weiser + 70 McLoughlin + 198 Stokes + 132 Trapp/Berger/Newland online excerpts + 204 Mueller/Kelly EWTN + 170 Elsa Chaney (1955) EWTN = 1,799 non-deduplicated source/detail research rows. Another 100 second-pass Mueller detail rows are preserved separately as NONADDITIVE to the 122 existing Mueller source observations. None is a count of distinct Catholic customs. Plus 127 French national intangible-heritage inventory detail observations (71 Brittany, 56 Basque), all source components/variants not 127 distinct practice families.
